title: Martial Law Orders of 1985 By Chief Martial Law Administrator No 101

sections.shortTitle: Martial Law Orders of 1985 By Chief Martial Law Administrator No 101
sections.section: ORDER - Martial Law Orders of 1985, By Chief Martial Law Administrator No. 101
sections.description:
MARTIAL LAW ORDERS By CHIEF MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR No
MARTIAL LAW ORDERS By CHIEF MARTIAL
LAW
ADMINISTRATOR No. 101
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 23rd December, 1984]
The following amendments shall be
carried out in Martial Law Order No. 3, hereinafter referred as the said M. L.
O. namely :-
In the said M. L. O. in paragraph
1, in sub-paragraph (b) in clause (vi) for the words, "Zone D-Lt.-Gen.
Sardar Farooq Shaukat Khan Lodi", the words "Zone D-Lt.-Gen. Khushdil
Khan Afridi" shall be substituted and shall be deemed to have been so
substituted w.e.f. 9th December, 1984.
